correctness.rationale: PASS: Scalar quadratic proximal maps are affine r_i x+eta a_i c_i/(1+eta a_i). Matching coefficients for every center vector forces p_i=(1+eta a_i)/(n+eta S); the conditional mean is the proximal map of the arithmetic mean. The finite family contracts, so a unique attracting stationary law exists. Centered independent affine recursion gives V=eta T/(S+U), lag covariance V R^k and averaging coefficient Gamma=(2n+eta S)T/[S(S+U)]. Two-component differentiation gives a nonnegative square; for (a,b,b) centers (0,1,-1) its exact derivative has sign a/b-1 for all eta>0, whereas single-iterate V strictly increases. Independent symbolic derivatives and rational stationary moment checks agree; finite checks only support analytic proof.

final_claim: For iid component-prox sampling on scalar positive quadratics, p_i=(1+eta a_i)/(n+eta S) is the unique all-center calibration matching E[prox_{eta f_I}]=prox_{eta F}; exact stationary average variance is nondecreasing for n=2 but strictly decreases for all eta when a<b in the specified (a,b,b),(0,1,-1) n=3 family.
limitations: Fixed eta iid scalar strictly convex quadratics, stationary averaging only; no nonstationary CLT or global algorithmic speed claim.
